author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಸರಿಯಿರಲು ಭಲೆಯೆನಲು ತಪ್ಪುಗಳ ತಿದ್ದಿರಲು
ಕರಪಿಡಿದು ನಡೆಸುದಕೆ ಹಿರಿಯರಿರಬೇಕು
ಅರಿವವರವೆಮಗೆಕೊಡೆ ಅನುಭವವು ಜೊತೆಗೂಡೆ
ತರಲಿಹವು ನೆಮ್ಮದಿಯ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: To say ‘well done’ when we are right, to correct our mistakes,
to take our hand and lead us, we need elders;
when they give us the boon of knowledge, and experience joins it,
they will bring us peace, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: We need elders who praise what is right, correct what is wrong and guide us by the hand. Their knowledge and experience bring peace to our lives.
